title: Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission in collaboration with Gas Industries Association organized a webinar on the topic of Standards of Oxygen on 30th April 2021
bodyHtml:
Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission in collaboration with Gas Industries Association organized a webinar on the topic of Standards of Oxygen on 30th April 2021. During the webinar, Mr. Prasenjit Chakrabarti, Senior Manager Quality of Linde South Asia delivered a talk on ‘Standards, Testing Methods and conversions between Industrial and Medical Oxygen’. Around one hundred participants attended the webinar and the presentation is available on the following link:

https://gasassociation.in/gia-news/Webinar_on_Standars_Testing_Method_&_Conv_Oxygen.pdfPDF (opens in a new tab)
